The line scan of resistivity (top right in (a) and (b)) displays the change in resistivity at the SE-active material interfaces. The 3D resistivity-topology scan (bottom) combines the resistivity data with z-height data, providing a simultaneous visualization of the topology of the sample and the corresponding resistivity.
